items.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025
items.q: You know Billy Strayhorn was an incredible composer.

ctx.x: What’s the average venue that you try to book, and I’m wondering if you’re required sometimes to explain what it is you’re doing if a club owner asks you -- well it’s not enough these days to say we play jazz. “Well what do you play? Trad jazz? Or do you do fusion?” Do you have an answer at the ready for that kind of situation?

It’s rough. It’s so difficult that one. And I sort of say, depending on the project, but with Satori I say it’s contemporary jazz. We do originals. And I might say sometimes in this – influenced by a certain person or it might seem that – if I’m trying to get a gig somewhere where they don’t necessarily know me I might look on my website and see who’s played that fits my genre I suppose, that is doing something similarly contemporary but not way out, kind of squeaky, honky, free jazz. And that’s not playing trad…
Do you ever do that? Play a 12-bar blues?
